description: This file defines an interface for a grain in Orleans that is used to inject storage faults for testing purposes. It includes methods to add faults on read, write, and clear operations, as well as methods to trigger exceptions during these operations.

classes.name: IStorageFaultGrain
classes.description: Interface for a grain that manages storage fault injection for testing purposes.

methods.name: AddFaultOnRead
methods.description: Adds a storage exception to be thrown when the referenced grain reads state from a storage provider.

methods.name: AddFaultOnWrite
methods.description: Adds a storage exception to be thrown when the referenced grain writes state to a storage provider.

methods.name: AddFaultOnClear
methods.description: Adds a storage exception to be thrown when the referenced grain clears state in a storage provider.

methods.name: OnRead
methods.description: Triggers a storage exception if one has been added for the grain reference for reading.

methods.name: OnWrite
methods.description: Triggers a storage exception if one has been added for the grain reference for writing.

methods.name: OnClear
methods.description: Triggers a storage exception if one has been added for the grain reference for clearing state.
